section_summary.evidence_source: Participants A total of 125 undergraduate college students from a large midwestern university participated in the current study. Individuals received course credit for participation in a 3-hr session in which they learned to operate a computer-based radar simulation and were paid $5 for completing the goal orientation measures. Fifty-eight percent of the participants were female, and most (88.8%) of the participants were between 18 and 21 years old.
